name: Basic Step
description: The foundation of salsa. A six-count pattern on 1-2-3, 5-6-7 with a pause on 4 and 8.

name: Cross Body Lead
description: The signature move of LA-style salsa. Leader steps aside and guides follower across while rotating 180°.

name: Right Turn
description: A single clockwise turn for the follower, initiated on count 1.

name: Left Turn
description: A single counter-clockwise turn for the follower, led with the left hand on count 1.

name: Copa
description: Leader steps behind follower on count 1 and guides a half-turn. Often used as a combo transition.

name: Enchufla
description: A cross-body lead where both partners turn simultaneously — the most iconic Cuban salsa move.
